zh.lead:
从器件与电路出发，

zh.introduction:
我在北京大学学习微电子与经济学，研究兴趣集中在忆阻器、存算一体与神经形态计算。

这里记录研究与项目，也收纳阅读、问题和写作。不同领域的材料会在这里慢慢连接起来。

en.lead:
Understanding computation,
from devices to systems.
en.introduction:
I study microelectronics and economics at Peking University. My research interests include memristive devices, compute-in-memory, and neuromorphic computing.

This is a place for my research interests, projects, and learning notes. I will add specific questions, methods, and shareable results as the work develops.
